messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — paging automation didn't reach oncall for the DB-latency alert (alert_id=31415). IncidentBot claims delivered but no one got paged. Starting live triage.
IncidentBot: POST /webhook -> pager-service returned 200 (req_id=abc123). Fanout attempted: 0 -> logged.
Jamal Singh: I'm seeing `500` -> `429` spikes in `notify-proxy` around 2024-11-04T22:10Z. snippet: `2024-11-04T22:10:12Z notify-proxy ERROR send_to_pagerflow 429 rate_limit_exceeded req_id=abc123`
Tina Park: Confirming — alertstream shows fanout_count=0 for alert_id=31415. Could be signing rotation or header stripping on retries. @IncidentBot can you print last webhook headers (redacted)?
IncidentBot: Last webhook headers (redacted): `X-Pagerflow-Alert: 31415`, `X-Signature: sha256=redacted`, `User-Agent: redwood-notify/1.2.0`. Note: retries include `X-Retry:1`.
Jamal Singh: Headers look OK. We deployed a change at 11:02 that modified retry path in `notify-proxy` — it may drop `X-Pagerflow-Alert` on 429 retries. Rolling back to previous image `gcr.io/redwood/notify-proxy:20241104-9f1a`.
Ravi Patel: Starting rollback on `notify-proxy` deployment now (kubectl rollout undo deployment/notify-proxy).
Elena Ruiz: Customer impact: ACME reported delayed incident call; three high-priority pages missed. CS notified and coordinating.
Maya Chen: Workaround: enable manual pager fallback while rollback completes: `./scripts/manual_page --team oncall --alert-id 31415`. Please run and ack.
Jamal Singh: :thumbsup: ran manual_page, pages sent and acknowledged by oncall.
Tina Park: After rollback we'll add an observability metric: `paging.fanout.count` and an alert when fanout==0 for >1m. Also add a deploy smoke-test that exercises paging.
IncidentBot: Rollback finished — `notify-proxy` pods 3/3 healthy, no 429s in the last 2m for that req_id window.
Maya Chen: Good. I'll create the incident ticket (INC-2024-31415) for postmortem and mitigation tasks, owners @Tina Park and @Jamal Singh. Thanks everyone for quick action.
Elena Ruiz: Notifying affected customers and logging the support timeline.
Tina Park: Action items: 1) Add fanout metric + alert, 2) Add smoke test to CI, 3) Revert retry header behavior and add integration test.
Maya Chen: Closing live triage thread — will update incident postmortem once owner assignments are confirmed. :white_check_mark:
